notes.title: Beta Patch Day
notes.notes:
It's Patchday, Patchday!
Gotta get down on Patchday!

A new Patch is online on the "Public Beta" Branch, here on Steam - enjoy it!

[previewyoutube=RUhmRl7H6qo;full][/previewyoutube]

Changelog below:
Added 10 new character traits across all departments
Balancing adjustments to item prices and requirements in emergencies (you will need more bomb kits!)
Fix objectives checklist removal (Chicago). The checklist objectives are removed when the objective is complete, no matter their stage of completion.
 Fix "Order in the zone" emergency type
 Fix EstablishSafeZone mission type
 Fix "Establish Safe Zone" questgiver line
 Fix various loca keys (Chicago)
 Fix ambus not unlocking (Chicago)

Enjoy the weekend!

notes.title: ❄️Winter is here update out now!
notes.notes:
Dashing through the snow with the new "Winter is here" update of your favorite Rescue HQ Tycoon which contains maaany great improvements like the Chicago in winter map!❄️Have fun! ⛄And remember, until 13.10. there is a 25% discount!
Changelog:

Added two new Scenarios: Chicago in Winter (Medium & Hard) Updated US Medical vehicles (visuals) 

Added 6 new character traits: 
PoliceBiochemical (Seasoned Police) +1 police on Biochemical emergencies 
PoliceStreetCop (Seasoned Police) +1 policestreet on Urban emergencies 
MedicIndustrial (Seasoned Medic) +1 medic on Industrial emergencies 
MedicHouseDoctor (Seasoned Medic) +1 medic on Urban emergencies 
MedicBiochemical (Seasoned Medic) +1 medic on Biochemical emergencies
FireFighterChemical (Seasoned Firefighter) +1 firefighter on Chemical emergencies 

And last, but not least, the feature everyone has been waiting for: 
Vehicles now drive away along the street
Language names are now in their respective language (not translated lol) - adjusted water area for emergencies 
Adjusted level 3 emergency chances for chicago contagion 
Several minor bugfixes regarding icons and scenario text 
Standard Ambulance has a new mesh for US 
Fixed subPump station missing preview mesh 
Added the icons for new actor traits in chicago scenarios 
Police now show up for day shift in chicago 
Buildable and purchasable ground in chicago now properly show snow / cleared state

notes.title: Rescue HQ - The Tycoon | #5 Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/85287b15b3938f657d360a73a51334879c5d6f77.png
Update time again! ːsteamhappyː
Updated HUD to be cleaner. Now highlights Performance Rating and shows weekly spending.
Updated Financial report UI and prediction algorithms for clearer visualization of weekly income and spending.
Fixed a nasty bug which lead to wages not being payed at End of Week.
Updated Shift Settings UI (at End of Week) to show filter and worker state more clearly.
Fixed some bugs, including not being able to change hotkeys because the popup did not show up.

notes.title: Update time!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/9ec40d66597dd93a3e67b308ec535ce86bcacbe3.gif

We just updated our Rescue HQ :-)!

- added ability to customize keybindings in settings menu (finally.)
- completely new and refreshing SF map scenery.
- added ability to toggle HIGH PRIORITY for any task - crew interrupt what they are doing if one of these tasks is unoccupied.
- tutorials are now accessible from any scenario (previously the "i" buttons only worked from specifically tagged scenarios)

- MODDERs: You can add a ModID string which circumvents steam workshop changing your mod names in-game (see wiki)
- MODDERs: An FMOD template project for RHQ was added to the Mod repository (see wiki)

notes.title: Rescue HQ - Update 3 Out Now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/9ec40d66597dd93a3e67b308ec535ce86bcacbe3.gif

Update #3 is now available!

 Major Changes: 

- @Someone's SFPD vehicles are now part of the mainmod, replacing the original SF Police vehicles. Thanks @Someone  
- Funding replacement of SFPD vehicles from old savegames
- Needs rebalance: Adjusted intervals & range variety to a higher spread, which makes situations like ALL THE CREW NEEDS TO PEE AT THE SAME TIME much less likely. 
- Mirror is now unlocked in SF :wink:

Dispatch Window: 
- Traits on actors now have a highlight if they synergize with an active emergency Tag 
- Changed equipment selection UI. Added a button to send out all available of a single type. 
- Added descriptions to all tooltips in "Required Assets" section (i.e. traits now describe what they do)  Actor Inspection 
- Added needs display for actors 
- Actor now shows department (if it exists)

Minor Changes & QoL 
- Vehicle Maintenance is enabled by default and does not turn off automatically 
- Jail Cell Bench is enabled by default and does not turn off automatically 
- Added mod compilation error messages 
- Additional ita loca improvements 
- several minor UI & layout updates

Squashed Bugs: 
- FIX dispatch map overlaying window 
- FIX font breaking with certain characters 
- FIX success rate tooltip being active from beginning
- FIX storage items were sent out when 0 are assigned in dispatch 
- FIX items were created when 0 are assigned in dispatch

notes.title: Rescue HQ - The Tycoon | #2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/85287b15b3938f657d360a73a51334879c5d6f77.png
In the last patch there were a few problems we want to fix with the hotfix now. We’ve fixed the problem with the firefighters and the station and have changed the endless mode a bit (Sandbox mod). 

We want to say thanks to everyone who took part in the fault repair and supported us and look forward to talk to you again with news soon! 
FIX: Actors use stations instead of ignoring them (happened when you had less than 10 people hired)
FIX: Left-most item in Timeline properly updates it's length
FIX: gain "Access All Areas" achievement when last object is unlocked
FIX: EndlessMode starts immediatly instead of waiting until next day shift (this also affected sandbox-mode, so you will get emergencies from the very beginning)
Vehicle HP bar visible in Dispatch menu
Vehicle HP numbers visible
Some UI colors tweaks (Top Left HUD, Timeline)

notes.title: Rescue HQ - The Tycoon | #1 Patch
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/85287b15b3938f657d360a73a51334879c5d6f77.png
Hey guys, our first greater patch is out. Please let us know your feedback!

Patchnotes:
added "Sandbox Berlin" scenario 
fixed vehicles not returning from some emergencies and at end of scenarios
added reputation gain to investigation board (tooltip already stated it but it didn't happen)
vehicles now have a limit for how many and which kinds of visitors they can carry (patients, prisoners)
fixed the trauma station alignment and access
performance optimization that increase FPS rates
fixed shooting range animations, no longer rotates on use
fixed assets not being loaded properly from mods downloaded from the steam workshop - existing asset-mods will need to be reuploaded.
fixed bug with outlines - they also now properly distinguish between "hovered" and "selected" object outline styles
camera movement bounds update according to level bounds
chinese: tutorial texts are no longer slightly cut off at top end


Your Rescue HQ - The Tycoon team
